=== PREDICTION OBJECTIVE ===
Predict the price direction of BTCUSDT over the NEXT 10 MINUTES.

Definitions (measured at the close of the 10-minute window):
- UP:    future price >= current price * 1.001  (+0.1% or more)
- DOWN:  future price <= current price * 0.999  (-0.1% or more)
- FLAT:  price moves within -0.1% to +0.1%

Decision rules:
- Base your prediction on order flow > price momentum > open interest > technical indicators.
- Order flow (CVD / TAKER) is the PRIMARY driver of short-term direction. Price-only signals are secondary.
- A spike in volume without a corresponding CVD push is NOT a directional signal.
- Open Interest changes validate the sustainability of a move:
    price up + OI up   = new longs entering, trend credible
    price up + OI down = short covering, move may fade
    price down + OI up = new shorts entering
    price down + OI down = long stop-outs / liquidations
- If conflicting or weak signals, choose FLAT rather than guessing.
- Confidence should reflect signal agreement across order flow, OI, and momentum.
